remarks: Welcome home! This beautiful completely renovated 2 bedroom townhouse 1 1/2 bath is perfectly situated in a very tranquil, peaceful, Silvermine community. Eat in kitchen is tastefully redone; quartz countertops, abundance of cabinets, and stainless-steel appliances. Additional improvements include bathrooms, hardwood floors, custom closet in primary bedroom, ceiling fans, and recessed lighting. All windows, skylights, and sliding glass door are updated energy efficient. Slider leads to a very private setting with view of woods, which is rare for condo living. Open and airy living room with working fireplace makes this home a perfect place for entertaining guests. Ample guest parking with reserved spot in front of unit. Close to Meritt 7 train, shopping, and all major highways. The pool has a clubhouse with kitchen. Schedule your private showings, this one will not last long.
